blocks.text: Sulfa drugs, antibacterial sulfonamides, mein sulfur hoti hai; print penicillins aur cephalosporins bhi ginwati hai, jin ke ring systems mein sulfur hai. Aam dawa omeprazole, jo GERD (gastro-oesophageal reflux disease) mein istemal hoti hai, sulfoxide group rakhti hai.

blocks.prompt: Omeprazole mein sulfur group pehchanein aur -SO2NH- group par bani antibacterial dawaon ki qism ka naam batayein.
blocks.explanation: Omeprazole mein sulfoxide hai, R-S(=O)-R. Antibacterial sulfonamides, sulfa drugs, sulfonamide group -SO2NH- par bani hain.

items: Drugs mein sulfur: sulfonamides (sulfa drugs); penicillins aur cephalosporins ke rings mein sulfur; omeprazole mein sulfoxide group.
